description.zh-Hans: 中文桌的旁白和台词写地道中文：旁白一件事接着一件事说，不一个动作一个句号；英文原文的「简短、干脆」是态度不是碎句；用逗号和虚词、语气词把话接起来，少用书面词、公文腔、被动和英式结构；口吻卡的示例问答也按中文习惯写。只改写法，不改事实和立场。
description.en: Chinese tables read and speak Chinese: narration runs one event into the next instead of a full stop per action; a book's clipped or curt speaker is a manner, not fragments; commas, aspect words and particles join the sentences, and written, official, passive or English-shaped phrasing stays out; voice cards' sample exchanges are written the Chinese way. Wording only; facts and positions do not change.
